name: manual-work-estimator
title: Manual work estimator
description: Turns the hours a team spends on repetitive manual tasks into a yearly cost and a realistic automation saving.

teamSize.title: People doing the work
teamSize.description: How many people spend time on the repetitive task.

hoursPerWeekEach.title: Hours per week, each
hoursPerWeekEach.description: Average hours each person spends on it per week.

hourlyCost.title: Cost per hour
hourlyCost.description: Fully loaded cost of one working hour, in your own currency.

automatablePercent.title: Share that can be automated (%)
automatablePercent.description: Be conservative. Work that needs judgment should not count.

buildCost.title: Cost to build the automation (optional)
buildCost.description: Adds a payback estimate when filled in.
